small_guidance: Inner IC loop reloads weight/input scalars one-at-a-time per output point — vectorize over IC by loading a [BLOCK_IC] slice of x and w per (kd,kh,kw) and using tl.sum, and hoist the bias add out. Also try BLOCK=256 with num_warps=8 and reorder loops so the IC reduction is innermost over a contiguous channel block.
large_guidance: Restructure as a scatter-add GEMM: one program per (N, input-spatial tile, IC tile) computing input × weight[IC,OC,KD,KH,KW] as a (TILE_IN × OC) outer product via tl.dot, then atomically adding into the strided output positions determined by stride/padding. Alternatively use the gather-GEMM form with one program per (N, OC tile, output-spatial tile) and an inner K loop over IC*KD*KH*KW with tl.dot on [BM,BK]x[BK,BN] tiles (BM=32,BN=64,BK=16, num_warps=4, num_stages=2), using channels_last layout so the IC axis is contiguous for coalesced loads. Fuse the BN affine + per-(N,C) mean subtraction epilogue; the mean can be computed in a small follow-up kernel since it needs the full spatial reduction.
